layout.house_prompt: A dental office with a reception-waiting area, two exam rooms, an X-ray room, a corridor, and a bathroom. The reception-waiting area has a reception desk with a computer and three chairs. The first exam room has a dental chair and a cabinet. The second exam room has a dental chair and a sink. The X-ray room has an X-ray machine. The corridor has a bench. The bathroom has a toilet and a sink.

corridor.text_description: A modern clean clinical dental corridor/clinical spine with a bench, bright neutral lighting, and borrowed light via high interior glazing/sidelights from the reception (privacy-preserving).

reception_waiting.text_description: A modern clean clinical dental office reception-waiting area with a reception desk with a computer and exactly three waiting chairs, clear sightlines to the entry, bright neutral lighting, and uncluttered minimal decor.

bathroom.text_description: A modern clean clinical bathroom with a toilet and a sink, privacy-focused simple design, and easy-clean tile surfaces.

exam_room_1.text_description: A modern clean clinical dental exam room with one dental chair and a cabinet for supplies, bright task lighting, and hygienic easy-clean finishes.

exam_room_2.text_description: A modern clean clinical dental exam room with one dental chair and a sink, bright task lighting, and hygienic easy-clean finishes.

xray_room.text_description: A modern clean clinical dental X-ray room with an X-ray machine, controlled lighting, and hygienic easy-clean finishes (no windows).
